summary: Add a visual rate graph and targeted practice for reading changing rates from experimental data.

improvements.why: Outcome 9701-8.1.3 asks learners to calculate rate from experimental data, while the note describes chord and tangent gradients without showing either on a graph.
improvements.what: Use graph_sketch for product concentration against time, with a rising curve that flattens, a labelled chord over an interval and a tangent at one time; annotate average versus instantaneous gradient and embed the rendered SVG in the note.

improvements.why: The only tangent item asks for a verbal method; there is no calculation of instantaneous rate from supplied tangent points.
improvements.what: Exam-style numeric item giving two well-separated points on a tangent to a concentration-time curve; calculate the instantaneous rate with the correct sign and unit.

improvements.where: note, after the existing worked example
improvements.why: The worked example covers only a straight average-rate calculation, but the method introduces instantaneous rate without a numerical demonstration.
improvements.what: Add a short worked tangent-gradient example using two points on a tangent to a reactant concentration-time curve, showing subtraction, negative gradient, positive disappearance rate and units.
